model.description: Declares a custom Drive App (a drive-level UI surface) shipped by a Vetra Reactor Package. Use one App Module document per drive app: configure which document types it handles, whether it accepts drag-and-drop, and mark it CONFIRMED to trigger codegen of the corresponding app scaffold under `editors/<app-id>/`.
model.name: App Module

modules.description: Set the app's identity, lifecycle status, and the document types it handles.
modules.name: BaseOperations

operations.description: Set the display name of the drive app. Also determines the generated folder name under `editors/`.
operations.name: SetAppName

operations.description: Move the app between DRAFT and CONFIRMED. Codegen only runs once the status is CONFIRMED.
operations.name: SetAppStatus

operations.description: Append a document type id to the list of types this app handles. The first type added narrows the app from every type to the listed ones.
operations.name: AddDocumentType

operations.description: Remove a document type id from the handled list. No-op if the type is not present. Removing the last type leaves an empty list, which accepts every type.
operations.name: RemoveDocumentType

operations.description: Replace the entire allowed-document-types list in one call. An empty list accepts every document type.
operations.name: SetDocumentTypes

modules.description: Toggle drag-and-drop file handling for the app surface.
modules.name: DndOperations

operations.description: Enable or disable drag-and-drop file handling on the app surface.
operations.name: SetDragAndDropEnabled

materialized.schema:
"""
Configuration for a Drive App contributed by the package. Drive apps render a
custom view at the drive level (instead of, or alongside, the document file
tree) and can opt into which document types they accept.
"""
type AppModuleState {
  "Display name of the drive app. Also used as the source for the generated folder name under `editors/`."
  name: String!
  "Lifecycle status. While DRAFT the app definition is editable and codegen is skipped; switching to CONFIRMED triggers app scaffold generation."
  status: StatusType!
  "Document type ids this app handles. `null` and an empty list both mean the app accepts every document type."
  allowedDocumentTypes: [String!]
  "Whether the app surface accepts dropped files from the user. Defaults to true."
  isDragAndDropEnabled: Boolean!
}

"""
Lifecycle status of a module definition.
- DRAFT: still being edited; codegen does not run.
- CONFIRMED: locked in; codegen produces the corresponding scaffold.
"""
enum StatusType {
  DRAFT
  CONFIRMED
}
